headline: GAUNTLET gets ten halls, warp arches and trap floors
lede: The overhead crawl grew Atari's deeper wings: six new mazes of iron, teal and obsidian, green arches that fling you forward two floors, and hazards that bite back — vanishing stone, stun sparks, teleport swirls, crumbling blocks and hidden passages. The autopilot cleared all ten before merge, and the attract demo now rides a warp in front of you.

notes.text: Ten-maze quest with warp exits (L5→7, L6→9, L8→10); FOUR HALLS stays the original four, and arches are guarded so they can never skip past the quest end.
Hazard furniture: two-blow breakable blocks, trap floors that bruise and shove, teleport pads, stun sparks, false walls — look and walkability are now separate so a hidden door reads as stone.
gauntletcheck 257 gates with 40/40 mutants dying, including a new dynamic bricked-arch guard; lesson logged: mutant runs are detached-only, nothing touches the tree while one lives.
